function: Excluded for function: the diffusion model only outputs power-splitting factors and power-control coefficients; MR and superposition-based precoders stay fixed, so no beam or precoder is learned (p. 5, 7).
notes: Excluded under function. p. 7: "using a diffusion model to obtain power-splitting factors and" power-control coefficients is the only learned step (trained on genetic-algorithm expert solutions, p. 9), and p. 5: "superposition-based precoding vc,l" with MR private precoding is fixed in Theorem 1. Power allocation is not among the seven areas, since area 3 covers precoder, beams and RIS phase shifts. Borderline: a reviewer who reads power-splitting and power-control of the precoders as part of area 3 would include it; the facts then are a custom correlated Rician model with three-slope path loss (p. 3, 9), a PPO-based DRL baseline (p. 12), a complexity order for the GAI algorithm (p. 9), and no code or data link. The PDF is the arXiv v2 preprint of the same paper.
